heading.title: Renovation Projects in the Greater Vancouver Area
heading.text: A look at completed renovation projects by VV Renovation — from commercial build-outs to detailed residential finishing. Each project combines our core trades: framing, drywall finishing, flooring, tile & stone, accent walls and painting.

projects.title: Yoga Studio Renovation in Langley
projects.imageAlt: Finished commercial yoga studio renovation with black mats and mirror wall in Langley, BC
projects.description: A full commercial studio build-out: framing, drywall and ceiling work, self-leveling, vinyl tile and yoga mat installation, decorative wall panels and detailed finishing.
